steps.message: Quick one-liner: bump the session timeout from 30 minutes to 8 hours in config.js. Just change the value, nothing fancy.

arguments.description: Show config file and list files

arguments.command: sed -i '' 's/SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 30,/SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 480,/' config.js && grep -n SESSION config.js server.js
arguments.description: Set session timeout to 480 minutes and check usages

steps.message: I changed `SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES` in `config.js:3` from `30` to `480`. The setting is in minutes, so 480 is 8 hours. The only place that uses it is the log line in `server.js`, which will now print `session timeout: 480m`. I haven't committed the change.
